_comment: Issue #1765, re-judged for #1949: a cavalry troop that breaks from a contagion flees and rallies without its men riding through each other, and re-forms where they come to rest. Player Cavalry (uid 0, 18 horses on 5 files: 3 full ranks and a 3-horse short rank) starts facing south at (700, 500) and is quarter-turned right (E) at tick 12, so it faces west. A weak Infantry company (uid 1, 8 men) stands south of it. The enemy Cavalry (uid 2) charges the company, which breaks at tick 169; the contagion (12 morale off every friend within 140 wu) breaks the troop too, and uid 0 reads ROUTING from tick 170. Each routed man runs north on his own (SoldierFlightStep), the troop rallies at tick 531 near the field's north edge, its men pull up on their own at their braking rate, and it re-forms where they come to rest: its grid is laid out at their centroid and each man is dealt the place nearest where he stands. Measured with dense 2-tick FULL dumps on seeds 0 to 4, 2026-11-13 on #1949's branch: no two of the troop's men stand within a body radius of each other at the break (ticks 170 and 172), at the rally (tick 531), or after the re-form (ticks 864 and 1080) (pairs_within_body_radius 0, pinned). #1765's pins read the slot grid: slots_across_centreline 0 and slot_lateral_excess 0 (tol 0.5 or 1.0 wu) at those ticks, claiming that the rout moved no slot and that the rally re-squared the fold in depth only. The bottom-up flight (#1949) removed the slot a routed man would keep and the fold and re-square the rally undid, so those eight pins are retired for the pairs_within_body_radius pins, which fail for a flight or a re-form that sends men through each other. The clip ends at tick 1100.

follow_error.reason: follow_error, the relational successor of shape_residual, reads uid0 56.54 against 30; uid2 37.74 against 30 on this tree (dense 2-tick FULL dump, Windows, seed 0, measured 2026-11-13); the slot-based shape_residual this exemption was written against read uid0 56.5; uid2 37.7. Original reason: uid 2 is the enemy cavalry (48 horses, frontage 12). After the company breaks it marches north after it from about tick 400, and its horses fall behind their slots as it goes: mean body-to-slot gap 10.1 wu at tick 460, 22.7 at 500, 34.4 at 600 and 45.1 at 660. That is the long-pursuit drift tracked in #1716, and main does the same: over this script's own state ticks, to the clip's end at tick 1100, the shape_residual worst reads 50.00 on main 4704cc91 and 54.77 here, against a 30 wu threshold; to tick 760 it read 41.03 and 40.29 (main 7d209821), so the rise is the longer chase. Measured 2026-10-11. uid 0 (the troop), for one phase only: after its re-square at tick 863 the 6 horses of its two outer files walk one cavalry rank (120 wu) forward at the idle arrival pace and arrive by about tick 1080 (mean body-to-slot gap 39.3 wu at tick 880, 22.0 at 960, 0.0 at 1080). The script declares state ticks every 10 between ticks 862 and 1080 so the regular scan sees that walk. On those ticks, and on 2-tick samples from tick 170 to tick 1100, its shape_residual reads 56.5 against the 30 wu threshold, and only between ticks 862 and 1080; outside that window it reads 8.85. The exemption is for that walk alone: a uid 0 shape_residual over 30 outside ticks 862 to 1080 is a new defect, not this one. On main 4704cc91 it reads 116.3, from the rout on. Tracked in #1807 (men lag rebuilt slots at the idle arrival pace). Measured 2026-10-11.
